data.raw_text:
The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) said on Thursday that it will ask local government units to ask mall owners to avoid conducting sales during peak days this holiday season to manage the traffic. 

“We are not prohibiting malls from conducting per store sales. What we are emphasizing is cooperation—especially in managing the surge of shoppers which directly impacts traffic,” said MMDA chairperson Romando Artes. 

Artes made the statement after he earlier said that the recent six-hour gridlock that brought Marcos Highway to a standstill was due to the simultaneous mall sales and uncoordinated truck ban policies.
